annotation.title_clean: Adopting robot lawyer? The extending artificial intelligence robot lawyer technology acceptance model for legal industry by an exploratory study
annotation.title_en: Adopting robot lawyer? The extending artificial intelligence robot lawyer technology acceptance model for legal industry by an exploratory study
annotation.summary_en: Journal article (abstract page) presenting an exploratory interview study with lawyers, judges, AI experts and clients, proposing an extended technology acceptance model for AI 'robot lawyers' with five facets and 11 elements, centred on legal use and perception of trust. It concerns software legal AI, not physical robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes an extended robot lawyer technology acceptance model with five facets and 11 elements.
Model highlights two dimensions: legal use and perception of trust.
Based on semistructured interviews with lawyers, judges, AI experts and potential clients.
AI robot lawyers can substitute some human abilities, but collaboration with human lawyers is imperative.
